title.zh: 卷524 列傳三百十一 藩部七 唐努乌梁海 阿尔泰乌梁海 阿尔泰淖尔乌梁海
title.en: Volume 524 Biographies 311: Frontier Dependencies 7: Tannu Uriankhai, Altai Uriankhai, Altai Nuur Uriankhai
title.raw: 卷524 列傳三百十一 藩部七 唐努乌梁海 阿尔泰乌梁海 阿尔泰淖尔乌梁海

sentences.zh: 唐努烏梁海，在烏裏雅蘇台之北，東南土謝圖汗部，南賽音諾顏部，西阿勒泰烏梁海，西南扎薩克圖汗部，北俄羅斯。

translations.literal: Tannu Uriankhai lies north of Uliastai; to the southeast is the Tüsheet Khan division; to the south the Sayin Noyan Khan division; to the west Altai Uriankhai; to the southwest the Zasagtu Khan division; to the north Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Tannu Uriankhai lies north of Uliastai, bordered on the southeast by the Tüsheet Khan division, on the south by the Sayin Noyan Khan division, on the west by Altai Uriankhai, on the southwest by the Zasagtu Khan division, and on the north by Russia.

sentences.zh: 有總管五：曰唐努，曰薩拉吉克，曰托錦，曰庫布蘇庫勒諾爾，曰奇木奇克河。

translations.literal: There are five superintendents: Tannu, Sarajik, Tojin, Kubusukul Nuur, and Chimchik River.
translations.idiomatic: It has five superintendents: Tannu, Sarajik, Tojin, Kubusukul Nuur, and Chimchik River.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十四年，扎薩克圖汗部和托輝特輔國公博貝隨大軍赴推河防準噶爾策妄阿拉布坦，言：「準噶爾不靖，恃烏梁海障之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi, the Zasagtu Khan division's Khoto Torghut Assistant State Duke Bobei followed the main army to the Tui River to guard against the Dzungar Tsewang Arabtan, saying: "The Dzungars are unsettled and rely on the Uriankhai as a shield.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi, Bobei, Assistant State Duke of the Khoto Torghut under the Zasagtu Khan division, marched with the main force to the Tui River to check the Dzungar leader Tsewang Arabtan. He said, "The Dzungars remain restless and depend on the Uriankhai as a barrier.

sentences.zh: 乞往招，若抗即以兵取。

translations.literal: I beg to go and summon them; if they resist, take them by force.
translations.idiomatic: I ask leave to go and win them over; if they resist, let us seize them by force.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克台吉濟納彌達阿裏雅及根敦羅卜藏克兵俱習戰，請與同往。

translations.literal: The Zasak taiji Jinamida Ariya and Gendun Lobzang's troops are all skilled in warfare; I ask to go together with them.
translations.idiomatic: The Zasak taiji Jinamida Ariya and Gendun Lobzang's men are all seasoned fighters; I ask to take them with me.

sentences.zh: 」上韙其議，從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his proposal and assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved the plan and granted his request.

sentences.zh: 九月，烏梁海頭目和羅爾邁率屬降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Uriankhai chief Galdan Ermai led his dependents in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Uriankhai leader Galdan Ermai brought his people in to submit.

sentences.zh: 先是和羅爾邁居吹河，嘗以越界射獵為博貝縛獻，上宥其罪，諭還巢。

translations.literal: Earlier Galdan Ermai had dwelt on the Chui River; once for hunting across the border he was bound and presented by Bobei; the emperor pardoned his offense and ordered him to return to his nest.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Ermai had earlier lived on the Chui River. Once, after he crossed the border to hunt, Bobei seized him and sent him in; the emperor pardoned him and told him to return home.

sentences.zh: 至是將遣子瑚洛處納請降。

translations.literal: At this time he was about to send his son Holochuna to request submission.
translations.idiomatic: Now he was about to send his son Holochuna to offer surrender.

sentences.zh: 博貝至，因遷其遊牧赴特斯。

translations.literal: When Bobei arrived, he accordingly moved their pastures to Tes.
translations.idiomatic: When Bobei arrived, he moved their herds to Tes.

sentences.zh: 冬，和羅爾邁遁，博貝追至呼爾罕什巴爾，執之。

translations.literal: In winter Galdan Ermai fled; Bobei pursued him to Hurkhan Shibar and seized him.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Galdan Ermai fled; Bobei chased him to Hurkhan Shibar and captured him.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，博貝擒烏梁海逃眾，晉貝勒。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year Bobei captured Uriankhai fugitives and was promoted to beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year Bobei rounded up fleeing Uriankhai and was promoted to beile rank.

sentences.zh: 時從征西將軍祁裏德軍。

translations.literal: At the time he was with the army of the Western Campaign General Qilide.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he was serving under Western Campaign General Qilide.

sentences.zh: 六十年六月，議政王大臣議覆祁裏德，新收烏梁海二千五百三十名，應送至巴顏諾爾克地方居住，令車臣汗等旗分派兵三百名，並派台吉協同駐紮防守。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixtieth year the Council of Princes and Ministers deliberated and replied to Qilide: the newly received Uriankhai, 2,530 persons, should be sent to dwell at Bayan Nuur; the Tsetsen Khan and other banners were ordered to assign 300 troops, and taiji were dispatched jointly to garrison and defend.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixtieth year the Council of Princes and Ministers replied to Qilide that the 2,530 Uriankhai just brought in should be settled at Bayan Nuur, with three hundred troops drawn from the Tsetsen Khan division and other banners and taiji sent to garrison the area jointly.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，諭曰：「朕詢貝勒博貝，管轄烏梁海何以資生。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng an edict said: "I inquired of Beile Bobei how the Uriankhai under his jurisdiction support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng the emperor said, "I asked Beile Bobei how the Uriankhai under his charge make their living.

sentences.zh: 據奏在將軍祁裏德處借餉一萬八千餘兩，買牲分給，各得產業，今勝於昔。

translations.literal: According to his memorial he borrowed more than 18,000 taels of provisions from General Qilide, bought livestock and distributed them, so that each gained a livelihood; now they are better off than before.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that he had borrowed more than eighteen thousand taels of provisions from General Qilide, bought livestock to distribute, and given each household a livelihood; they are now better off than before.

sentences.zh: 所有借項，自以貝勒俸逐年扣抵。

translations.literal: All borrowed sums were to be deducted year by year from the beile's salary.
translations.idiomatic: The debt was to be repaid year by year from his beile stipend.

sentences.zh: 朕思烏梁海俱朕之百姓，豈有朕之百姓而借餉於朕之理？

translations.literal: I reflect that the Uriankhai are all My subjects—how can there be a principle of My subjects borrowing provisions from Me?
translations.idiomatic: I consider the Uriankhai all my people—how can my own subjects be made to borrow provisions from me?

sentences.zh: 所借銀兩，不必扣還。

translations.literal: The borrowed silver need not be repaid.
translations.idiomatic: The silver borrowed need not be repaid.

sentences.zh: 諭祁裏德知之。

translations.literal: Qilide was instructed to know this.
translations.idiomatic: Qilide was informed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」三年，烏梁海和羅爾邁復遁，由阿哩克竄準噶爾界，博貝遣子額璘沁由托濟邀擒，而自赴克木克木齊克緝叛黨，誅之。

translations.literal: " In the third year the Uriankhai Galdan Ermai fled again, slipping through Alik into Dzungar territory; Bobei sent his son Elinqin to intercept and capture him by Toji, while he himself went to Kemkemchik to round up rebel partisans and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third year Galdan Ermai fled again, crossing through Alik into Dzungar lands. Bobei sent his son Elinqin to cut him off at Toji and take him, while he himself went to Kemkemchik to hunt down rebel bands and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 初額魯特與喀爾喀構兵時，錯處科布多、烏蘭固木。

translations.literal: When the Oirats and Khalkha first made war, they were misplaced at Kobdo and Ulan Gumu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Oirats and Khalkha first fought, they were settled at Kobdo and Ulan Gumu by mistake.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹既滅，喀爾喀西境直抵阿勒泰，自唐努山陰之克木克木齊克至博木等處，皆博貝及來歸之額魯特貝淩旺布所屬烏梁海遊牧。

translations.literal: After Galdan was destroyed, Khalkha's western border reached straight to the Altai; from Kemkemchik on the shady side of the Tannu Mountains to Bomu and other places, all were pastures of Uriankhai belonging to Bobei and the returned Oirat beile Lingwangbu.
translations.idiomatic: After Galdan's defeat the Khalkha western frontier ran to the Altai; from Kemkemchik on the northern slopes of the Tannu range to Bomu and beyond, all was Uriankhai pasture held by Bobei and the returned Oirat beile Lingwangbu.

sentences.zh: 四年，策旺阿拉布坦言克木克木齊克舊隸準噶爾，乞還，上不許，慮伺間略烏梁海，詔博貝率所部兵千，隨前鋒統領定壽駐唐努山陽特斯地方防護之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Tsewang Arabtan said Kemkemchik had formerly belonged to the Dzungars and begged its return; the emperor did not permit it, fearing he would watch for an opening to raid the Uriankhai, and ordered Bobei to lead a thousand troops of his division and with Vanguard Commander Ding Shou garrison the sunny-side Tes region south of the Tannu Mountains to protect them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Tsewang Arabtan claimed Kemkemchik had once belonged to the Dzungars and asked for it back. The emperor refused, fearing he would seize a chance to harry the Uriankhai, and ordered Bobei to lead a thousand of his men with Vanguard Commander Ding Shou to garrison Tes on the southern slopes of the Tannu Mountains as a guard.

sentences.zh: 尋諭理籓院曰：「朕詳思克木克木齊克烏梁海皆博貝所屬，和羅爾邁既已就擒，交博貝撫恤，居之公所。

translations.literal: Soon the Court of Colonial Affairs was instructed: "I have carefully considered that the Kemkemchik Uriankhai all belong to Bobei; since Galdan Ermai has already been captured, hand him to Bobei to comfort and care for, and let him dwell at the public lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Court of Colonial Affairs was told, "I have reflected that the Kemkemchik Uriankhai all belong to Bobei. Galdan Ermai is already in custody; let Bobei care for him and house him at the public lodge.

sentences.zh: 但念此等人向在喀爾喀邊外林木中射獵為生，與準噶爾所屬烏梁海接壤，又與俄羅斯連界。

translations.literal: But bearing in mind that these people have always lived by hunting in the forests beyond the Khalkha border, border the Dzungar Uriankhai, and also adjoin Russia—
translations.idiomatic: But remember that they have always lived by hunting in the woods beyond the Khalkha frontier, that they border Dzungar Uriankhai lands, and that they also adjoin Russia.

sentences.zh: 宜令博貝等同大臣前往曉諭，令自為預備，以防不虞。

translations.literal: Bobei and other ministers should be ordered to go and instruct them, that they make their own preparations against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: Bobei and the other ministers should go and instruct them to prepare on their own against any surprise.

sentences.zh: 」三月，命大臣一員帶布帛茶葉賞克木克木齊克地方烏梁海，並令揀老成服眾之人作為首領。

translations.literal: " In the third month a minister was ordered to bring cloth, silk, and tea as rewards for the Kemkemchik Uriankhai, and to select mature men who commanded the people's respect to serve as leaders.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third month a minister was sent with cloth, silk, and tea to reward the Kemkemchik Uriankhai and to choose respected elders among them as leaders.

sentences.zh: 五年，額駙策淩等與俄羅斯訂約，自恰克圖、鄂爾輝圖兩間為界，所立之鄂博，迤西至肯哲馮達霍呢音嶺、克木克木齊克之博木、沙弼納嶺。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the imperial son-in-law Tsewang Rabdan and others concluded a treaty with Russia; from between Kyakhta and Ergui the boundary markers established ran west to Kenje Fengda Honin Ridge, Bomu at Kemkemchik, and Shibina Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the imperial son-in-law Tsewang Rabdan and others made a treaty with Russia. From between Kyakhta and Ergui the boundary markers ran west to Kenje Fengda Honin Ridge, Bomu at Kemkemchik, and Shibina Ridge.

sentences.zh: 循此山梁，由正中分中劃界，其兩邊各取五貂之烏梁海，仍令照舊各歸其主，彼此各徵一貂之烏梁海。

translations.literal: Following this mountain ridge, the boundary was drawn down the middle; on each side five-sable Uriankhai were taken, still left as before each to their own master, while each side also levied one-sable Uriankhai from the other.
translations.idiomatic: Along this ridge the border was split down the middle. Five-sable Uriankhai on each side were left to their former masters, while each side also exacted tribute of one-sable Uriankhai from the other.

sentences.zh: 自定界之日，將各取一貂之處停止。

translations.literal: From the day the boundary was fixed, the levying of one-sable Uriankhai on each side was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: From the day the border was fixed, the mutual levy of one-sable Uriankhai was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十六年，以和托輝特扎薩克貝勒青袞咱卜縱所屬人私出汛界與準噶爾回眾貿易，致潛居烏梁海，奪貝勒，詔額璘沁襲其爵，定烏梁海出入汛界例。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Qianlong, because the Khoto Torghut Zasak Beile Chingunjab allowed his people privately to cross the patrol boundary to trade with Dzungar Muslims, causing them to dwell stealthily among the Uriankhai, his beile rank was stripped; Elinqin was ordered to inherit his title, and regulations were fixed for Uriankhai crossing the patrol boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Qianlong the Khoto Torghut Zasak Beile Chingunjab was stripped of his rank for letting his people cross the patrol line to trade with Dzungar Muslims and settle secretly among the Uriankhai. Elinqin was ordered to succeed him, and rules were set for Uriankhai movement across the patrol boundary.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，青袞咱卜脅烏梁海叛，大兵至，皆棄去。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Chingunjab coerced the Uriankhai into rebellion; when the great army arrived, all abandoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Chingunjab forced the Uriankhai into revolt; when the imperial army arrived, they all deserted him.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，鑄唐努烏梁海總管印給之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year a Tannu Uriankhai superintendent seal was cast and given.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year a superintendent's seal for Tannu Uriankhai was cast and issued.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣額樂春以需索烏梁海奪職治罪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing the Uliastai Participating Minister Elechun was stripped of office and punished for extorting the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing the Uliastai Participating Minister Elechun was dismissed and punished for extorting the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，定禁烏梁海與商民貿易例，以山西民人私向烏梁海買取羊只涉訟。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang regulations forbidding trade between Uriankhai and merchant civilians were fixed, because Shanxi commoners privately bought sheep from the Uriankhai and lawsuits arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daoguang trade between the Uriankhai and Han merchants was banned after Shanxi traders' private purchases of sheep led to lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍桂輪劾總管垂敦紮布需索無厭，奪職。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year the Uliastai General Guilun memorialized that Superintendent Chuidunjab's extortions were insatiable; his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year Uliastai General Guilun reported that Superintendent Chuidunjab's demands were endless, and he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 咸豐年，奏唐努烏梁海界址。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng years a memorial was submitted on the boundaries of Tannu Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng reign the boundaries of Tannu Uriankhai were reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 十年，與俄國定界約，是部之沙賓達巴哈實為西疆劃界之第一地段。

translations.literal: In the tenth year a boundary treaty was concluded with Russia; this tribe's Sabin Daba was in fact the first sector of the western frontier demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year a border treaty was made with Russia; Sabin Daba in this region was the first sector where the western frontier was marked out.

sentences.zh: 同治三年十一月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍明誼等奏：「唐努烏梁海遊牧內，俄使前開議單，載唐努鄂拉達巴哈即系唐努山嶺，自沙賓達巴哈界牌起，先往西，後往南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Tongzhi the Uliastai General Mingyi and others memorialized: "Within the Tannu Uriankhai pastures, the Russian envoy's earlier negotiation list states that Tannu Ol Daba is the Tannu mountain ridge; from the Sabin Daba boundary marker it runs first west, then south.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of Tongzhi Uliastai General Mingyi and others reported, "Within Tannu Uriankhai grazing lands the Russian envoy's earlier negotiating paper says Tannu Ol Daba is the Tannu ridge; from the Sabin Daba marker the line runs west first, then south.

sentences.zh: 亦據該使呈繪圖志，有順薩彥山嶺至奎屯鄂博所有界限地名。

translations.literal: According also to the maps and gazetteers presented by that envoy, there are boundary place-names from along the Sayan ridge to Kuitun oboo.
translations.idiomatic: The maps and gazetteers the envoy submitted also list boundary place-names from along the Sayan ridge to Kuitun oboo.

sentences.zh: 我國舊存圖內雖無其地名，然據該使所指方向，續經庫倫辦事大臣文盛送雍正五年已定交界圖志，名目雖殊，界限大致相似。

translations.literal: Although our old preserved maps lack these place-names, according to the direction indicated by that envoy, the Urga Minister Wensheng later sent boundary maps and gazetteers fixed in the fifth year of Yongzheng; though the names differ, the boundaries are broadly similar.
translations.idiomatic: Our older maps do not show these names, but following the route the envoy indicated, Urga Minister Wensheng later sent boundary maps from the fifth year of Yongzheng; the names differ, yet the lines largely match.

sentences.zh: 唐努烏梁海遊牧雖有被俄人包去之嫌，與西二盟遊牧無礙。

translations.literal: Although Tannu Uriankhai pastures may appear in danger of being encircled by Russians, the pastures of the two western leagues are unaffected.
translations.idiomatic: Tannu Uriankhai pastures may look as if Russians could hem them in, but grazing in the two western leagues would not be affected.

sentences.zh: 明年立界時，俟與麟興、車林敦多布等妥商辦理。

translations.literal: When the boundary is erected next year, we await proper consultation and handling with Lin Xing, Cheren Dundob, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When the markers are set next year, the matter should be settled in consultation with Lin Xing, Cheren Dundob, and the others.

sentences.zh: 」四年八月，麟興等奏：「據委員岳嵩武稟報，與唐努烏梁海總管凡齊爾馳赴博果素克大壩履勘起，沿站按圖詳查，行至唐努鄂拉達巴哈，核與俄國所畫唐努鄂拉達巴哈邊界相符。

translations.literal: " In the eighth month of the fourth year Lin Xing and others memorialized: "According to Commissioner Yue Songwu's report, starting from an on-site survey at Bogusuk Dam with Tannu Uriankhai Superintendent Fanqier, checking in detail station by station along the map, upon reaching Tannu Ol Daba it was verified to match the Tannu Ol Daba boundary drawn by Russia.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth month of the fourth year Lin Xing and others reported that Commissioner Yue Songwu, starting from an on-site survey at Bogusuk Dam with Tannu Uriankhai Superintendent Fanqier and checking each station against the map, found Tannu Ol Daba matched the boundary Russia had drawn.

sentences.zh: 除薩彥山因無路徑不能履勘，其唐努鄂拉達巴哈及邊境應分之珠嚕淖爾、塔斯啟勒山、哈喇塔蘇爾山、德布色克哈山數處，擇擬立界處所，繪會勘圖志呈閱。

translations.literal: Except Sayan Mountain, which could not be surveyed for lack of a path, at Tannu Ol Daba and several places on the border to be divided—Zhuru Nuur, Tasqiler Mountain, Haratasur Mountain, Debu Sekha Mountain—sites for erecting boundary markers were chosen and joint-survey maps and gazetteers drawn for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Sayan Mountain could not be surveyed for lack of a trail. At Tannu Ol Daba and other points on the border to be divided—Zhuru Nuur, Tasqiler Mountain, Haratasur Mountain, and Debu Sekha Mountain—they chose sites for markers and submitted joint-survey maps.

sentences.zh: 」時俄立界使臣以事不能至。

translations.literal: " At that time the Russian boundary commissioner could not come on account of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " The Russian boundary commissioner could not come at that time.

sentences.zh: 九月，明誼等以軍務緊急，請緩約俄使立界。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Mingyi and others, because military affairs were urgent, asked to postpone the appointment with the Russian envoy to erect the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mingyi and others, citing urgent military affairs, asked to postpone setting the boundary with the Russian envoy.

sentences.zh: 六年，俄人遂越界至總管邁達爾遊牧內烏克果勒地方建屋種地。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Russians crossed the boundary into Superintendent Maidar's pastures at Ukgol, building houses and planting fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Russians crossed the border into Superintendent Maidar's pastures at Ukgol and built houses and planted fields.

sentences.zh: 總理各國事務衙門照會俄使，始由庫倫俄官行文令送之回國。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen addressed a note to the Russian envoy; only then did the Russian official at Urga send documents ordering them sent back to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen protested to the Russian envoy, and only then did the Russian official at Urga order them sent home.

sentences.zh: 是年，廷旨促麟興等建立西疆毗連俄境界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: That year a court edict urged Lin Xing and others to erect boundary markers and oboo on the western frontier adjoining Russia.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court ordered Lin Xing and others to set up boundary markers along the western frontier adjoining Russia.

sentences.zh: 六月，專命榮全迅與俄官會立烏裏雅蘇台邊卡界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Rongquan alone was specially ordered promptly to meet Russian officials and jointly erect Uliastai frontier-post boundary markers and oboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Rongquan was ordered to meet Russian officials at once and set up Uliastai frontier boundary markers.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，榮全與俄使穆魯木策夫至是部西南之賽留格木山嶺會立牌博，於是月二十六日起行，順賽留格木嶺至是部西南邊境盡處之博果蘇克壩，立第一界牌鄂博，科城立牌博於南，俄國立牌博於西。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year Rongquan and the Russian envoy Murumtsev came to this tribe's Saylugem mountain ridge in the southwest to erect markers jointly; setting out on the twenty-sixth of that month, they followed the Saylugem ridge to Bogusuk Dam at the extreme southwestern border of this tribe and erected the first boundary marker and oboo, with Kobdo's marker to the south and Russia's to the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year Rongquan and Russian envoy Murumtsev met on this tribe's southwestern Saylugem ridge to set the first markers. They set out on the twenty-sixth, followed the ridge to Bogusuk Dam at the southwestern tip of the region, and erected the first marker, with Kobdo's to the south and Russia's to the west.

sentences.zh: 由此向東北約八十里，名塔斯啟勒山，於山頂立第二牌博。

translations.literal: From here northeast about eighty li, at a place called Tasqiler Mountain, the second marker and oboo were erected on the summit.
translations.idiomatic: About eighty li northeast, at Tasqiler Mountain, they set the second marker on the summit.

sentences.zh: 又向東北約九十里，至珠嚕淖爾，俄使言只就珠嚕淖爾迤北數十里唐努山之察布齊雅壩止，建立鄂博，由此直向西北，統至沙賓達巴哈，路既便捷，尤易行走。

translations.literal: Again northeast about ninety li to Zhuru Nuur; the Russian envoy said oboo should be erected only as far north of Zhuru Nuur as Chabuqiya Dam on the Tannu Mountains, then straight northwest in one line to Sabin Daba—the route being convenient and especially easy to travel.
translations.idiomatic: Another ninety li northeast brought them to Zhuru Nuur. The Russian envoy proposed markers only as far north as Chabuqiya Dam on the Tannu range, then a straight line northwest to Sabin Daba—a route he called shorter and easier.

sentences.zh: 榮全以俄使所指之路俱系是部遊牧內地，若照俄使所議，不惟與原圖大不相符，且將是部遊牧包去大半，向俄使反復開導，仍如原圖，於珠嚕淖爾東南之哈爾根山立第三牌博。

translations.literal: Rongquan said the route the Russian envoy indicated was all within this tribe's pasturelands; if the Russian proposal were followed, it would not only greatly diverge from the original map but also encircle most of this tribe's pastures; he repeatedly instructed the Russian envoy and, still following the original map, erected the third marker at Hargen Mountain southeast of Zhuru Nuur.
translations.idiomatic: Rongquan argued that the Russian route lay entirely within this tribe's pastures; accepting it would not only depart from the original map but would cut off most of their grazing. After repeated negotiations he followed the original map and set the third marker at Hargen Mountain southeast of Zhuru Nuur.

sentences.zh: 順淖爾北岸約二十餘里，至唐努山南察布齊雅壩，立第四牌博。

translations.literal: Along the north shore of the lake about twenty-odd li, to Chabuqiya Dam south of the Tannu Mountains, the fourth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Following the north shore of the lake for some twenty li, they set the fourth marker at Chabuqiya Dam on the southern slopes of the Tannu range.

sentences.zh: 沿唐努山南，向西過莫多圖河、紮勒都倫河、烏爾圖河、察罕紮克蘇圖河，順哈喇塔蘇爾海山，至沙克魯河，轉向東北約二百五十餘里，至庫色爾壩，系是部西方邊界，立第五牌博。

translations.literal: Along the south of the Tannu Mountains, west past the Modotu, Zhaladun, Wurtu, and Chahan Zhaksutu rivers, following Haratasur Sea Mountain to the Shakru River, then turning northeast about 250-odd li to Kusier Dam, the western border of this tribe, the fifth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: They followed the southern Tannu slopes west past the Modotu, Zhaladun, Wurtu, and Chahan Zhaksutu rivers, along Haratasur Sea Mountain to the Shakru River, then northeast some 250 li to Kusier Dam on this tribe's western frontier, where they set the fifth marker.

sentences.zh: 向西北九十餘里，至唐努鄂拉達巴哈末處，過哈喇河偏西山下楚拉察水流之處，立第六牌博。

translations.literal: Northwest ninety-odd li to the end of Tannu Ol Daba, crossing west of the Hala River where the Chulacha stream flows below the mountain, the sixth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety li northwest they reached the end of Tannu Ol Daba and set the sixth marker west of the Hala River where the Chulacha stream runs below the mountain.

sentences.zh: 向北又東，順薩彥山過瑪納瑚河、蒙納克河、浩拉什河，由喀喇淖爾至蘇爾大壩，約一百五十里，立第七牌博。

translations.literal: North and then east, following the Sayan Mountains past the Manahu, Monak, and Haolashi rivers, from Kara Nuur to Sur Dam, about 150 li, the seventh marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Turning north and east along the Sayan range past the Manahu, Monak, and Haolashi rivers, from Kara Nuur to Sur Dam, about 150 li, they erected the seventh marker.

sentences.zh: 向北又東約三百六十餘里，山脈連貫，直至沙賓達巴哈，於舊牌博之東山頂上立第八牌博。

translations.literal: North and east again about 360-odd li, the mountain ranges continuous, straight to Sabin Daba; on the eastern summit of the old marker the eighth marker was erected.
translations.idiomatic: Another 360 li north and east along the continuous ridges to Sabin Daba, they set the eighth marker on the eastern summit beside the old marker.

sentences.zh: 照原圖至賽留格木山博果蘇克壩上，紅線以左為中國地，紅線以右為俄國地。

translations.literal: According to the original map to Bogusuk Dam on Saylugem Mountain, land to the left of the red line was Chinese territory and to the right Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original map, from Bogusuk Dam on Saylugem Mountain, land left of the red line was Chinese and land to the right was Russian.

sentences.zh: 至六月二十二日竣事，而是部阿勒泰河、阿穆哈河區域皆入於俄。

translations.literal: On the twenty-second day of the sixth month the work was completed, yet the Altai River and Amuha River regions of this tribe all passed to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The work was finished on the twenty-second of the sixth month, but the Altai River and Amuha River regions of this tribe had all fallen to Russia.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，烏裏雅蘇台將軍以奇木齊克河總管報俄商在唐努烏梁海屬建蓋行棧數處，及春季以來，有俄人或三五十人或八九十人不等，在奇木齊克河北一帶中唐努山內刨挖金砂，例應禁止，咨總理各國事務衙門照會俄署使凱陽德轉飭邊官查禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu the Uliastai General reported on the Chimchik River superintendent's word that Russian merchants had built several trading lodges within Tannu Uriankhai jurisdiction, and since spring Russians in groups of thirty to fifty or eighty to ninety had been digging gold sand within the Tannu Mountains north of the Chimchik River—all forbidden by regulation; he consulted the Zongli Yamen to address a note to Acting Russian Minister Keshande to instruct frontier officials to investigate and forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Guangxu the Uliastai General reported that the Chimchik River superintendent said Russian merchants had built several trading posts in Tannu Uriankhai territory and that since spring groups of thirty to ninety Russians had been panning gold inside the Tannu range north of the Chimchik River, all in violation of regulations. He asked the Zongli Yamen to protest to Acting Minister Keshande and have frontier officials stop it.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍以俄人在薩爾魯克地方居住，紮立木棚十處，附近挖過金砂大小凡一百餘處，照會俄駐庫領事迅飭邊界官嚴禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year the Uliastai General reported Russians dwelling at Sarluq, erecting ten wooden sheds, with more than a hundred large and small gold-digging sites nearby; a note was addressed to the Russian consul at Urga urgently instructing frontier officials strictly to forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year the Uliastai General reported Russians living at Sarluq with ten wooden huts and more than a hundred gold pits nearby, and protested to the Russian consul at Urga to have frontier officials enforce the ban.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍杜嘎爾奏稱：「所轄唐努烏梁海屬地邊外自柏郭蘇克西北至沙賓達巴罕，中國設立界牌，每年夏季派員會同查閱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year Uliastai General Dugar memorialized: "On the outer border of Tannu Uriankhai territory under my jurisdiction, from northwest of Bogusuk to Sabin Dabahan, China has erected boundary markers; each summer personnel are dispatched jointly to inspect them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year Uliastai General Dugar reported, "On the outer border of Tannu Uriankhai under my jurisdiction, from northwest of Bogusuk to Sabin Dabahan, China has set boundary markers that are inspected jointly each summer.

sentences.zh: 其嶺一東一南，至烏裏雅蘇台，即嶺之左，歸中國屬，載在條約。

translations.literal: The ridge runs east and south to Uliastai; land to the left of the ridge belongs to China, as recorded in the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The ridge runs east and south toward Uliastai; territory to the left of the ridge belongs to China, as the treaty states.

sentences.zh: 乃俄人竟於沙賓達巴罕以東，霍呢章達巴罕以西，唐努所屬爾裏黨、薩布塔爾、都不達果勒、車爾裏克、荊格等河岸地方，前經查驗過俄人挖金共四十五處，至今仍在薩布塔爾、車爾裏克兩處附近河岸開挖甚多。

translations.literal: Yet Russians have actually east of Sabin Dabahan and west of Honizhang Dabahan, on the riverbanks of Erlidang, Sabtar, Budabagor, Cherik, Jingge and other places belonging to Tannu—where inspection earlier found forty-five Russian gold-digging sites—continued to dig extensively on the riverbanks near Sabtar and Cherik.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Russians have been mining east of Sabin Dabahan and west of Honizhang Dabahan on Tannu riverbanks at Erlidang, Sabtar, Budabagor, Cherik, Jingge, and elsewhere. An earlier inspection found forty-five pits; digging near Sabtar and Cherik continues on a large scale.

sentences.zh: 烏克、多倫兩河地方，俄人明固賴等任意開墾地畝，長一千三百餘廣尺，寬八百二十餘廣尺。

translations.literal: At the Wuke and Duolun rivers Russians such as Mingulai have arbitrarily opened fields more than 1,300 chang in length and 820-odd chang in width.
translations.idiomatic: At the Wuke and Duolun rivers Russians including Mingulai have cleared fields more than 1,300 chang long and over 820 chang wide.

sentences.zh: 俄人雅固爾等於薩拉塔木、博木、額奇布拉克、多倫、烏克、車爾裏克、托勒博、薩斯多克、密崗嚕勒、紮庫勒、哈達努額奇依斯克、木阿瑪、阿克河口、吉爾噶琥河口、吉爾紮拉克等十五處建蓋堅屋，南入我境至數百之多。

translations.literal: Russians such as Yagur have built solid houses at fifteen places—Salatamu, Bomu, Eqibrak, Duolun, Wuke, Cherik, Tolebo, Sasidok, Miganglule, Zhakule, Hadanu Eqiyisk, Muama, the mouth of the Ake River, the mouth of the Jiergahu River, Jierzhalak—pushing south into our territory to the number of several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Russians including Yagur have built sturdy houses at fifteen sites—Salatamu, Bomu, Eqibrak, Duolun, Wuke, Cherik, Tolebo, Sasidok, Miganglule, Zhakule, Hadanu Eqiyisk, Muama, the Ake River mouth, the Jiergahu River mouth, and Jierzhalak—several hundred of them pushing deep into Chinese territory.

sentences.zh: 本年派佐領榮昌等往烏梁海吉爾拉裏克地方會俄官辯論挖金、蓋房、種地各案，俄官一味支吾，執意不辦，應由總理各國事務衙門逐件查覆。

translations.literal: This year Assistant Commandant Rongchang and others were sent to the Uriankhai Jierlalik place to meet Russian officials and argue the cases of gold-digging, house-building, and land cultivation; the Russian officials only equivocated and stubbornly refused to act; the Zongli Yamen should investigate and reply item by item.
translations.idiomatic: This year Assistant Commandant Rongchang and others were sent to Jierlalik in Uriankhai territory to negotiate with Russian officials over mining, building, and farming. The Russians only stalled and refused to act; the Zongli Yamen should investigate each case and report back.

sentences.zh: 」旋由總理事務衙門覆奏：「請飭將軍等詳勘界限，研究根由，援據約章，與俄酋竭力辯論。

translations.literal: " Soon the Zongli Yamen memorialized in reply: "We ask that the generals and others survey the boundary in detail, study the root causes, cite the treaty provisions, and argue strenuously with the Russian chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: " The Zongli Yamen soon replied, asking the generals to survey the boundary, trace the causes, cite the treaties, and press the Russians hard.

sentences.zh: 倘彼堅執，或應知照駐俄使臣，嚴請外部妥籌辦法，或即估給蓋房之費，令從速遷徙，由將軍等就近相機籌定，奏明辦理。

translations.literal: If they persist stubbornly, either our minister in Russia should be notified to press the foreign ministry strictly for a proper solution, or the cost of their houses should be estimated and paid so they may be ordered to move quickly—the generals nearby to devise measures as circumstances allow and memorialize for handling.
translations.idiomatic: If they remain obstinate, either notify our minister in Russia to demand a settlement from the foreign ministry, or estimate the cost of their buildings and pay them to leave at once, with the local generals to decide as circumstances require and report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」十月，祥麟等奏覆派吉玉等由烏梁海印務處於六月自廕木噶拉泰起程，履勘車爾裏克等處，往返兩月有餘，已將俄人在境內挖金、蓋房、種地三事詳細查明，繕單入告。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month Xianglin and others memorialized in reply that Jiyu and others had been sent from the Uriankhai seal office, setting out in the sixth month from Yinmugaltai, surveying on site at Cherik and other places, traveling back and forth for more than two months, and had investigated in detail the three matters of Russians digging gold, building houses, and cultivating land within the border, drawing up lists for report.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth month Xianglin and others reported that Jiyu and others had left the Uriankhai seal office in the sixth month from Yinmugaltai, spent more than two months surveying Cherik and other places, and had fully documented Russian mining, building, and farming inside the border.

sentences.zh: 命總理各國事務衙門照會俄使，將越界在唐努烏梁海挖金、蓋房、種地之背約俄人遷回本國。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen was ordered to address a note to the Russian envoy to remove to their own country the treaty-breaking Russians who had crossed the boundary to dig gold, build houses, and cultivate land in Tannu Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen was ordered to demand that Russians who had crossed into Tannu Uriankhai to mine, build, and farm in violation of treaty be sent home.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月，烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣志銳以奇木齊克河總管請給印奏入，命連順察看情形，奏明辦理。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year the Uliastai Participating Minister Zhirui memorialized on the Chimchik River superintendent's request for a seal; Lianshun was ordered to examine the situation and memorialize for handling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year Participating Minister Zhirui reported the Chimchik River superintendent's request for an official seal; Lianshun was told to investigate and report back.

sentences.zh: 尋覆奏，以「奇木齊克河與唐努總管相隔實在千里之外，中間橫亙賽音諾顏部之額魯特扎薩克貝子達克丹多爾濟所屬烏梁海，遇有齟<齒吾>，文報不通，凡事轉報總管，未能直達烏城。

translations.literal: Soon a reply memorial stated: "Chimchik River and the Tannu superintendent are in fact separated by a thousand li; between them lies the Uriankhai of the Sayin Noyan division's Oirat Zasak Beizi Dakdan Dorji; when friction arises, documents cannot pass, and everything must be relayed through the superintendent and cannot reach Uliastai directly.
translations.idiomatic: A follow-up memorial explained that Chimchik River and the Tannu superintendent are a thousand li apart, with the Uriankhai of Oirat Zasak Beizi Dakdan Dorji of the Sayin Noyan division in between. When disputes arise, messages cannot get through and everything must go through the Tannu superintendent rather than directly to Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 奇木齊克河實有二千一十三戶，丁口已幾萬人。

translations.literal: Chimchik River in fact has 2,013 households, with registered males numbering nearly ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Chimchik River has 2,013 households and nearly ten thousand registered males.

sentences.zh: 唐努總管每年勒派各情，亦所恆有。

translations.literal: The Tannu superintendent's annual forced levies of all kinds are also a constant occurrence.
translations.idiomatic: The Tannu superintendent's annual exactions are also routine.

sentences.zh: 其他毗連俄界，交涉事多。

translations.literal: Moreover it adjoins the Russian border, and border affairs are numerous.
translations.idiomatic: It also borders Russia, and frontier affairs are frequent.

sentences.zh: 既，十蘇木連結懇求，是與唐努總管其心已離，兩不相下，倘有事故，亦難收拾。

translations.literal: Moreover the ten sumu have joined in earnest petition; their hearts have already parted from the Tannu superintendent, neither side yielding to the other; should an incident occur, it would also be hard to manage.
translations.idiomatic: The ten sumu have united in petition; they are already estranged from the Tannu superintendent and neither side will yield. If trouble breaks out, it will be hard to control.

sentences.zh: 若將數十年仰希朝廷之恩，一旦下頒，必能自固籓籬，為我遮罩。

translations.literal: If the grace they have looked up to from the court for decades were once granted from above, they would surely strengthen their own frontier fence and serve as a screen for us.
translations.idiomatic: If the court's grace, long awaited, were granted at last, they would surely hold their own frontier and serve as a shield for us.

sentences.zh: 況有東烏梁海請印在前，似難以不符體制為解，請仍賞給印信」。

translations.literal: Moreover Eastern Uriankhai's prior request for a seal makes it hard to plead incompatibility with regulations; we ask that a seal still be bestowed."
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Uriankhai already received a seal, so precedent makes it hard to refuse on grounds of regulations; we ask that a seal be granted."

sentences.zh: 得旨，如所請。

translations.literal: An edict was received: as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，詔連順等備邊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Lianshun and others were ordered to prepare the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Lianshun and others were ordered to ready the frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 時拳匪事起，中外人心惶惑。

translations.literal: At the time the Boxer affair arose and Chinese and foreigners alike were anxious and unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The Boxer rising had begun, and Chinese and foreigners alike were uneasy.

sentences.zh: 連順檄唐努烏梁海總管棍布多爾濟、薩拉吉克烏梁海總管巴勒錦呢瑪、托錦烏梁海總管淩魁、庫布蘇庫勒諾爾烏梁海總管克什克濟爾噶勒、奇木齊克河烏梁海總管海都布調兵練團，嚴密舉辦。

translations.literal: Lianshun issued orders to Tannu Uriankhai Superintendent Gunbodorji, Sarajik Uriankhai Superintendent Balejinima, Tojin Uriankhai Superintendent Lingkui, Kubusukul Nuur Uriankhai Superintendent Keshkjiergal, and Chimchik River Uriankhai Superintendent Haidubu to mobilize troops and drill militia, carrying this out strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Lianshun ordered Tannu Uriankhai Superintendent Gunbodorji, Sarajik Superintendent Balejinima, Tojin Superintendent Lingkui, Kubusukul Nuur Superintendent Keshkjiergal, and Chimchik River Superintendent Haidubu to raise troops and drill militia without delay.

sentences.zh: 棍布多爾濟等均能刻日成軍。

translations.literal: Gunbodorji and the others were all able to form armies within days.
translations.idiomatic: Gunbodorji and the others each raised a force within days.

sentences.zh: 復籌幫軍食，擇要加兵防守，善待俄商，毋生邊釁。

translations.literal: He also planned aid for army provisions, chose key points to add troops for defense, treated Russian merchants well, and forbade provoking border incidents.
translations.idiomatic: He also arranged supplies for the troops, reinforced key posts, treated Russian merchants well, and warned against provoking border clashes.

sentences.zh: 二十八年十二月，連順等再請獎敘，疏入，予克什克濟爾噶勒二品頂戴，海都布二品花翎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twenty-eighth year Lianshun and others again requested rewards; the memorial entered, and Keshkjiergal was given a second-rank official's hat button, Haidubu a second-rank peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-eighth year Lianshun again asked for rewards; Keshkjiergal received a second-rank hat button and Haidubu a second-rank peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 是年，連順以「烏梁海向風沐化幾二百年，直與喀爾喀蒙古無異。

translations.literal: That year Lianshun stated: "The Uriankhai have received civilization for nearly two hundred years and are directly no different from Khalkha Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: That year Lianshun wrote, "The Uriankhai have been under imperial civilization for nearly two hundred years and are scarcely different from the Khalkha Mongols.

sentences.zh: 我國商民仍守舊規，不敢違禁潛往貿易。

translations.literal: Our country's merchant civilians still observe the old regulations and dare not violate the ban by going secretly to trade.
translations.idiomatic: Our merchants still obey the old rules and dare not trade there in secret.

sentences.zh: 至俄商之在烏梁海貿易者，不計其數，建蓋房屋，常年居住，每年收買鹿茸、狐、狼、水獺、猞猁猻、貂皮、灰鼠，為款甚钜，致烏梁海來烏城呈交貢皮時，竟至無貨可以貿易。

translations.literal: As for Russian merchants trading in Uriankhai, they are countless; they build houses and dwell year-round, each year buying antlers, fox, wolf, otter, lynx, sable, and squirrel pelts in very large sums, so that when Uriankhai come to Uliastai to present tribute pelts, there is in fact no goods left to trade.
translations.idiomatic: Russian traders in Uriankhai territory are beyond counting. They build houses and live there year-round, buying up antlers, fox, wolf, otter, lynx, sable, and squirrel pelts in huge quantities, so that when Uriankhai come to Uliastai with tribute furs there is often nothing left to trade.

sentences.zh: 惟有變通辦理，如在烏城貿易商民原赴烏梁海貿易者，准即報官前往，仍由將軍衙門照章酌給六個月限票，並嚴飭守卡官兵認真稽查，不准挾帶違禁之物」。

translations.literal: There is only to handle this flexibly: merchant civilians at Uliastai who formerly went to trade in Uriankhai may be permitted to report to officials and go, still receiving from the general's yamen according to regulations a six-month travel permit as appropriate, and garrison troops at the barrier posts are strictly ordered to inspect conscientiously and not allow contraband to be carried."
translations.idiomatic: The only remedy is flexibility: Uliastai merchants who used to trade in Uriankhai may register and go, with the general's office issuing six-month passes as regulations provide, while barrier garrison troops are ordered to inspect strictly and bar contraband."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，烏裏雅蘇台將軍堃岫等以奇木齊克河總管海都布率奏本旗十蘇木公揀海都布長子達魯噶布音巴達爾琥辦事勤能，眾心傾服，請補總管，允之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong the Uliastai General Kunxiu and others reported that Chimchik River Superintendent Haidubu led the memorial of this banner's ten sumu elders selecting Haidubu's eldest son Darugabuyin Badarhu as diligent and capable in affairs, winning the people's hearts; they asked that he be appointed superintendent, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong General Kunxiu reported that Chimchik River Superintendent Haidubu and the ten sumu elders recommended his eldest son Darugabuyin Badarhu as diligent and widely respected, and asked that he succeed as superintendent; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 是部天和土腴，有灌溉之利，宜麥。

translations.literal: This tribe enjoys mild heaven and fertile soil, with the benefit of irrigation, suitable for wheat.
translations.idiomatic: The region has a mild climate and rich soil, with irrigation suitable for wheat.

sentences.zh: 有金、銅、石棉諸礦，林木亦富。

translations.literal: There are gold, copper, asbestos, and other mines; timber is also abundant.
translations.idiomatic: It has gold, copper, asbestos, and other minerals, and abundant forests.

sentences.zh: 達布遜山產石鹽，是部全境及科布多北部皆資之。

translations.literal: Dabuxun Mountain produces rock salt, on which this tribe's entire territory and northern Kobdo all rely.
translations.idiomatic: Dabuxun Mountain yields rock salt that supplies this entire region and northern Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 唐努、薩拉吉克、托錦三總管各有佐領四，庫布蘇庫勒諾爾總管佐領二，奇木齊克河總管佐領十。

translations.literal: The three superintendents of Tannu, Sarajik, and Tojin each have four assistant commandants; the Kubusukul Nuur superintendent has two assistant commandants; the Chimchik River superintendent has ten assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: The Tannu, Sarajik, and Tojin superintendents each have four assistant commandants; Kubusukul Nuur has two; Chimchik River has ten.

sentences.zh: 薩拉吉克別名薩爾吉格，托錦別名陶吉，總管皆無印。

translations.literal: Sarajik is also called Sargig; Tojin is also called Taoji; their superintendents all have no seals.
translations.idiomatic: Sarajik is also known as Sargig and Tojin as Taoji; their superintendents hold no official seals.

sentences.zh: 庫布蘇庫勒諾爾別名庫蘇古淖爾，奇木齊克河別名肯木次克，有印。

translations.literal: Kubusukul Nuur is also called Kusugu Nuur; Chimchik River is also called Kenmucik; they have seals.
translations.idiomatic: Kubusukul Nuur is also called Kusugu Nuur and Chimchik River as Kenmucik; these offices have seals.

sentences.zh: 此外扎薩克圖汗部右翼右旗有五佐領：一在庫蘇古爾泊北，一在華克穆河東北，一在格德勒爾河西，一在謨什克河西，一在紮庫爾河源。

translations.literal: Besides these, the Zasagtu Khan division's Right Wing Right Banner has five assistant commandants: one north of Lake Kusugur, one northeast of the Khakmu River, one west of the Gedeler River, one west of the Moshik River, and one at the source of the Zhakur River.
translations.idiomatic: The Zasagtu Khan division's Right Wing Right Banner also has five assistant commandants: north of Lake Kusugur, northeast of the Khakmu River, west of the Gedeler River, west of the Moshik River, and at the Zhakur headwaters.

sentences.zh: 賽音諾顏部額魯特貝子旗佐領十三，皆南依鄂爾噶汗山，西接阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海。

translations.literal: The Sayin Noyan division's Oirat beizi banner has thirteen assistant commandants, all south along Mount Erge Khan, adjoining Altai Nuur Uriankhai on the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Sayin Noyan division's Oirat beizi banner has thirteen assistant commandants along the southern slopes of Mount Erge Khan, bordering Altai Nuur Uriankhai to the west.

sentences.zh: 哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖徒眾所屬佐領三，西臨華克穆河。

translations.literal: Three assistant commandants belong to the disciples of the Jebzundamba Khutuktu, bordering the Khakmu River on the west.
translations.idiomatic: Three assistant commandants serve the Jebzundamba Khutuktu's followers along the Khakmu River to the west.

sentences.zh: 阿勒泰烏梁海，在科布多之西，東額魯特，東南紮哈沁及布勒罕河新土爾扈特、哈弼察克新和碩特，南和博克薩里舊土爾扈特，東北杜爾伯特，北阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海。

translations.literal: Altai Uriankhai lies west of Kobdo; to the east the Oirats; to the southeast Zhakhachin and the Bulgan River New Torghut and Khobchak New Khoshut; to the south the Hoboksar Old Torghut; to the northeast the Dorbod; to the north Altai Nuur Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: Altai Uriankhai lies west of Kobdo, bordered on the east by the Oirats, on the southeast by the Zhakhachin and the Bulgan River New Torghut and Khobchak New Khoshut, on the south by the Hoboksar Old Torghut, on the northeast by the Dorbod, and on the north by Altai Nuur Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 分左右翼，左翼旗四，右翼旗三。

translations.literal: They are divided into left and right wings: four left-wing banners and three right-wing banners.
translations.idiomatic: They are organized in left and right wings, with four left-wing banners and three right-wing banners.

sentences.zh: 初屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: They originally belonged to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: They were originally subject to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗等台吉達什朋素克隨北路軍營參贊大臣薩喇爾擒私入科布多汛之烏梁海人紮木圖等。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong the Khalkha Zasagtu Khan division taiji Dashpensok, with Northern Route Army Camp Participating Minister Salar, captured the Uriankhai Zhamutu and others who had privately entered the Kobdo patrol zone.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong the Khalkha Zasagtu Khan taiji Dashpensok, serving with Northern Route Participating Minister Salar, seized the Uriankhai Zhamutu and others who had crossed into the Kobdo patrol zone.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月，命薩喇爾等統兵征入卡之準噶爾屬烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year Salar and others were ordered to command troops against the Dzungar Uriankhai who had entered the barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year Salar and others were ordered to campaign against Dzungar Uriankhai who had crossed the barrier line.

sentences.zh: 釋北路軍營誘捕之烏梁海禡木特等，令回部落。

translations.literal: The Northern Route Army Camp released the Uriankhai Mamut and others who had been lured and captured, ordering them to return to their tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Route command released the Uriankhai Mamut and others who had been lured into capture and sent them back to their tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月，準噶爾烏梁海庫木來降。

translations.literal: In the second month the Dzungar Uriankhai Kumu came in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Dzungar Uriankhai leader Kumu submitted.

sentences.zh: 三月，命舒赫德赴卓克索地方會薩喇爾招撫烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the third month Shuhede was ordered to go to Zhuokeso to join Salar in winning over the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Shuhede was sent to Zhuokeso to join Salar in pacifying the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 尋以烏梁海徙牧額爾齊斯等地，令暫撤兵。

translations.literal: Soon because the Uriankhai moved their pastures to the Irtysh and other places, troops were ordered temporarily withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai soon moved their herds to the Irtysh region, and the troops were ordered to withdraw for the time being.

sentences.zh: 是月，以收撫烏梁海，移北路軍營於烏裏雅蘇台。

translations.literal: That month, because the Uriankhai were being won over, the Northern Route Army Camp was moved to Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Northern Route headquarters was moved to Uliastai as the Uriankhai submitted.

sentences.zh: 七月，賽音諾顏貝子車木楚克紮布暨班第、薩喇爾等擊烏梁海宰桑於察罕烏蘇，降之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Sayin Noyan beizi Chemchukjab together with Bandi, Salar, and others attacked Uriankhai zaisang at Chahan Usu and received their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Sayin Noyan beizi Chemchukjab, Bandi, Salar, and others defeated Uriankhai zaisang at Chahan Usu and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 十月，班第、薩喇爾進兵降阿勒泰居住之準噶爾烏梁海宰桑禡木特及通禡木特，收戶口千餘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Bandi and Salar advanced and received the surrender of the Dzungar Uriankhai zaisang Mamut and Tongmamut dwelling at the Altai, taking over more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Bandi and Salar subdued the Dzungar Uriankhai zaisang Mamut and Tongmamut living in the Altai, bringing in more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 復由阿勒泰赴索爾畢嶺，進至布林漢之察漢托輝額貝和碩地方，獲宰桑庫克新等。

translations.literal: Again from the Altai they went to Solbi Ridge, advancing to Chahan Tohui Ebe Khoshu in Bulghan, capturing zaisang Kukxin and others.
translations.idiomatic: From the Altai they marched to Solbi Ridge and on to Chahan Tohui Ebe Khoshu in Bulghan, capturing zaisang Kukxin and others.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以收撫烏梁海，加和托輝特貝勒青袞咱卜郡王銜，編設烏梁海人戶旗分佐領，諭授宰桑車根、赤倫、察達克總管，命庫克新於額爾齊斯屯田。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, for winning over the Uriankhai, Khoto Torghut Beile Chingunjab was given the rank of junwang; Uriankhai households were organized into banners with assistant commandants; zaisang Chegen, Chilen, and Chadak were appointed superintendents; Kukxin was ordered to farm garrison lands on the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Chingunjab, Khoto Torghut beile, was raised to junwang for helping pacify the Uriankhai. Uriankhai households were organized into banners with assistant commandants; zaisang Chegen, Chilen, and Chadak were made superintendents; and Kukxin was ordered to farm on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，察達克等兵至華額爾齊斯河收穫包沁宰桑等。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year Chadak's troops reached the Hua Irtysh River and captured the Baoxin zaisang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year Chadak's forces reached the upper Irtysh and captured the Baoxin zaisang and others.

sentences.zh: 授察達克副都統，予烏梁海總管赤倫副都統銜，命招撫汗哈屯之烏梁海人眾。

translations.literal: Chadak was appointed vice commander-in-chief; Uriankhai superintendent Chilen was given the rank of vice commander-in-chief; he was ordered to win over the Uriankhai people of Khan Hatun.
translations.idiomatic: Chadak was made vice commander-in-chief and Uriankhai superintendent Chilen received the same rank, with orders to win over the Uriankhai of Khan Hatun.

sentences.zh: 免烏梁海等貢賦一年。

translations.literal: Uriankhai tribute and levies were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai tribute and levies were waived for one year.

sentences.zh: 二月，編察達克、赤倫所屬烏梁海為佐領七。

translations.literal: In the second month the Uriankhai under Chadak and Chilen were organized into seven assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Uriankhai under Chadak and Chilen were organized into seven assistant commandant districts.

sentences.zh: 三月，烏梁海宰桑都塔齊以指示投順之人逃竄正法，命扎薩克圖汗部扎薩克台吉根敦等駐防海喇圖、科布多等處，管烏梁海遊牧，接收降人。

translations.literal: In the third month the Uriankhai zaisang Dutachi was executed by law for causing submitted persons whom he had directed to flee; the Zasagtu Khan division Zasak taiji Gendun and others were ordered to garrison Hailatu, Kobdo, and other places, administer Uriankhai pastures, and receive those who surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Uriankhai zaisang Dutachi was executed for letting submitted people he had guided escape. Zasak taiji Gendun of the Zasagtu Khan division and others were posted at Hailatu, Kobdo, and elsewhere to oversee Uriankhai pastures and receive defectors.

sentences.zh: 四月，汗哈屯地方烏梁海歸順。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Uriankhai of the Khan Hatun region submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Uriankhai of Khan Hatun submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月，授歸順之烏梁海宰桑圖布新為總管。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the submitting Uriankhai zaisang Tubxin was appointed superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the submitting Uriankhai zaisang Tubxin was made superintendent.

sentences.zh: 十月，以烏梁海出牲畜接濟哈達哈西進之軍，嘉賚之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, because the Uriankhai supplied livestock to support Hadaha's western advance army, they were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Uriankhai were rewarded for supplying livestock to Hadaha's army marching west.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，以阿逆煽動烏梁海，哈薩克道梗。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year, because the rebel incited the Uriankhai, the Kazakh route was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-first year the rebel stirred up the Uriankhai and blocked the Kazakh trade route.

sentences.zh: 詔哈達哈剿烏梁海叛賊。

translations.literal: Hadaha was ordered to suppress the Uriankhai rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Hadaha was ordered to suppress the rebel Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 有固爾班和卓者，奇爾吉斯宰桑，攜千餘戶潛赴烏梁海，賽音諾顏郡王車布登紮布及車登三丕勒邀擒之。

translations.literal: There was one Gurban Khoja, a Kirghiz zaisang, who secretly went to the Uriankhai with more than a thousand households; the Sayin Noyan junwang Chebudenjab and Cheden Sanbil intercepted and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: A Kirghiz zaisang named Gurban Khoja slipped into Uriankhai lands with more than a thousand households; Sayin Noyan junwang Chebudenjab and Cheden Sanbil intercepted and captured him.

sentences.zh: 六月，青袞咱卜叛，誘新舊烏梁海附己。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Chingunjab rebelled and induced the new and old Uriankhai to join him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Chingunjab rebelled and tried to win both the new and old Uriankhai to his side.

sentences.zh: 大兵至，皆來效順。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, all came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army arrived, they all submitted.

sentences.zh: 十月，以新舊烏梁海等備兵請討青袞咱卜，嘉賚之，授察達克內大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, because the new and old Uriankhai and others prepared troops and asked to campaign against Chingunjab, they were rewarded; Chadak was appointed grand minister of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the new and old Uriankhai were rewarded for raising troops to fight Chingunjab, and Chadak was made grand minister of the interior.

sentences.zh: 二十二年二月，命察達克等防範准部叛賊達什車淩等逃入烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-second year Chadak and others were ordered to guard against Dzungar rebel Tsewang Rabdan and others fleeing into Uriankhai territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-second year Chadak and others were ordered to block Dzungar rebels such as Tsewang Rabdan from fleeing into Uriankhai lands.

sentences.zh: 四月，以額魯特叛賊車布登多爾濟屬人分給察達克等。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the dependents of the Oirat rebel Chebuden Dorji were distributed to Chadak and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the followers of the Oirat rebel Chebuden Dorji were assigned to Chadak and others.

sentences.zh: 論察達克等俘輝特賊人功，予其子侍衛賚圖布慎、赤倫、洪郭爾等緞茶各有差。

translations.literal: Chadak and others were commended for capturing Khoit rebels; his son bodyguard Baichubushen, Chilen, Hongguor, and others were given silk and tea in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Chadak and others were rewarded for capturing Khoit rebels; his son the bodyguard Baichubushen, Chilen, Hongguor, and others received silk and tea in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 九月，命車布登紮布等防範阿逆等擾烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Chebudenjab and others were ordered to guard against the rebel and others harassing the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chebudenjab and others were ordered to guard the Uriankhai against the rebel and his followers.

sentences.zh: 十月，以阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海內附，諭授官加賞，定察達克所屬烏梁海每戶歲納二貂，給俸如內地官吏之半。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, because Altai Nuur Uriankhai submitted inward, offices and added rewards were granted; the Uriankhai under Chadak were fixed at two sables per household yearly, with salaries at half those of interior officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Altai Nuur Uriankhai submitted; offices and rewards were granted, Chadak's Uriankhai were set at two sables per household per year, and salaries at half the rate of interior officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月，命烏梁海、紮哈沁人等歸還馬駝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Uriankhai, Zhakhachin, and others were ordered to return horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Uriankhai, Zhakhachin, and others were ordered to return horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海博和勒復降，仍授總管。

translations.literal: The Uriankhai Bohele submitted again and was still appointed superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai leader Bohele submitted again and was reappointed superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二十三年二月，歸併烏梁海管轄人戶編入之，允新舊烏梁海均於烏蘭固木種地，於吹河、勒和碩等處遊牧。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-third year households under Uriankhai jurisdiction were merged and enrolled; the new and old Uriankhai were both permitted to farm at Ulan Gumu and pasture at the Chui River, Leheshuo, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-third year Uriankhai households were merged and enrolled; both new and old Uriankhai were allowed to farm at Ulan Gumu and graze along the Chui River, Leheshuo, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 尋命移科布多烏梁海徙就阿爾泰山陽。

translations.literal: Soon the Kobdo Uriankhai were ordered moved to the sunny side of the Altai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Kobdo Uriankhai were ordered to move to the southern slopes of the Altai.

sentences.zh: 二十四年三月，仍命郡王車布登紮布總理烏梁海事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year Junwang Chebudenjab was again ordered to oversee Uriankhai affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year Junwang Chebudenjab was again put in charge of Uriankhai affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，烏梁海副都統莫尼紮布等招降鄂爾楚克人戶，附入烏梁海大臣管轄，授官有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Uriankhai vice commander-in-chief Monijab and others won over Ertchuk households, attached to Uriankhai minister jurisdiction, and offices were granted in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Uriankhai vice commander Monijab and others won over Ertchuk households, placed them under Uriankhai ministerial jurisdiction, and granted offices in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 是年，定阿爾泰山之南額爾齊斯為是部牧地。

translations.literal: That year the Irtysh south of the Altai Mountains was fixed as this tribe's pastureland.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Irtysh south of the Altai was assigned as this tribe's pasture.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以哈薩克人掠烏梁海，諭察達克等防剿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, because Kazakhs raided the Uriankhai, Chadak and others were instructed to guard and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Chadak and others were ordered to guard against Kazakh raids on the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 二十五年四月，以收撫烏梁海原任總管阿喇逃散屬人交察達克等兼管。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year, for winning over the scattered dependents of former Uriankhai superintendent Ala who had fled, they were handed to Chadak and others for joint administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year the scattered followers of former superintendent Ala were placed under Chadak and others for joint administration.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海總管紮布罕疏脫賊犯，上以年幼宥之，命察達克派員協同辦事。

translations.literal: Uriankhai superintendent Zabukhan was negligent and let bandits escape; the emperor pardoned him for his youth and ordered Chadak to dispatch personnel to assist in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendent Zabukhan let bandits escape through negligence; the emperor pardoned him for his youth and ordered Chadak to send men to assist him.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月，禁烏梁海私向哈薩克貿易。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year private trade between Uriankhai and Kazakhs was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year private trade between the Uriankhai and Kazakhs was banned.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，允展烏梁海卡坐。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year expansion of Uriankhai barrier posts was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year the expansion of Uriankhai barrier posts was approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，嚴禁阿勒泰烏梁海竊取哈薩克馬匹。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Altai Uriankhai theft of Kazakh horses was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Altai Uriankhai were strictly forbidden to steal Kazakh horses.

sentences.zh: 十月，以前經內附續逃入俄羅斯之烏梁海庫克新假我烏梁海名劫掠哈薩克，命察達克等領兵捕治之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, because the Uriankhai Kukxin who had earlier submitted but later fled to Russia was raiding Kazakhs in our Uriankhai name, Chadak and others were ordered to lead troops to capture and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Kukxin, a Uriankhai who had submitted but fled to Russia, was raiding Kazakhs in China's name; Chadak and others were ordered to capture him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，鑄烏梁海左、右翼總管印，分給察達克、圖克慎，銷原領阿勒泰烏梁海總管印。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month left- and right-wing Uriankhai superintendent seals were cast and given to Chadak and Tukushen; the former Altai Uriankhai superintendent seal was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month seals for the left- and right-wing Uriankhai superintendents were cast for Chadak and Tukushen, and the old Altai Uriankhai superintendent seal was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十八年正月，庫克新就擒，戮之，以招撫人戶給察達克等分轄。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year Kukxin was captured and executed; the households won over were distributed to Chadak and others for divided jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year Kukxin was captured and executed; the households he had won over were divided among Chadak and others.

sentences.zh: 三十八年十二月，以新土爾扈特郡王舍楞與是部散秩大臣烏爾圖那遜為婚，諭烏梁海緊接俄羅斯，瑚圖靈阿等嗣後詳為留意。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the thirty-eighth year, because the New Torghut junwang Sheleng married this tribe's minister without regular rank Wurtunason, it was instructed that the Uriankhai adjoin Russia closely and Hutuling'a and others should hereafter pay detailed attention.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirty-eighth year New Torghut junwang Sheleng married this tribe's minister without regular rank Wurtunason; officials were warned that the Uriankhai border Russia closely and Hutuling'a and others must watch the frontier carefully hereafter.

sentences.zh: 四十九年六月，給阿勒泰台站內大臣察達克轄烏梁海官兵協濟銀兩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the forty-ninth year silver for mutual aid was given to the Uriankhai troops and officers under Altai station grand minister Chadak.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the forty-ninth year aid silver was granted to the Uriankhai troops under Altai station minister Chadak.

sentences.zh: 道光十八年，以哈薩克潛闌入阿勒泰烏梁海，命烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣車林多爾濟領蒙兵逐之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang, because Kazakhs secretly crossed into Altai Uriankhai, the Uliastai Participating Minister Cheren Dorji was ordered to lead Mongol troops to drive them out.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang Kazakhs crossed secretly into Altai Uriankhai; Uliastai Participating Minister Cheren Dorji was ordered to drive them out with Mongol troops.

sentences.zh: 科布多參贊大臣毓書遣科布多主事職銜哈楚暹領兵逐入烏梁海之哈薩克依滿等於烏裏雅蘇台。

translations.literal: The Kobdo Participating Minister Yushu sent Kobdo director-rank Hachuxian with troops to drive the Kazakhs Yiman and others who had entered Uriankhai territory to Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Participating Minister Yushu sent director-rank Hachuxian to drive the Kazakhs Yiman and others who had entered Uriankhai lands toward Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 八月，追敗之于沙拉布拉克。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they were pursued and defeated at Shalaburak.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they were pursued and defeated at Shalaburak.

sentences.zh: 九月，又逐再入烏梁海之哈薩克，使過於庫克伸阿林，予獎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Kazakhs who again entered Uriankhai were again driven out, made to cross beyond Kukshin Alin, and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Kazakhs who entered Uriankhai again were driven beyond Kukshin Alin and the officers were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十一月，車林多爾濟奏前入烏梁海土爾扈特之哈薩克驅逐已淨，獲十餘人釋之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Cheren Dorji memorialized that the Kazakhs who had earlier entered Torghut Uriankhai territory had been completely driven out; more than ten captives were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Cheren Dorji reported that the Kazakhs who had entered Torghut Uriankhai lands were fully driven out; more than ten captives were released.

sentences.zh: 十二月，予烏梁海副都統車伯克達什等花翎，以論驅逐潛入遊牧哈薩克勞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Uriankhai vice commander-in-chief Chebokedash and others were given peacock feathers for their labor in driving off Kazakhs who had stealthily entered the pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Uriankhai vice commander Chebokedash and others received peacock feathers for driving off Kazakhs who had slipped into the pastures.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，哈薩克復入烏梁海，命車林多爾濟復調兵逐之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year Kazakhs again entered Uriankhai; Cheren Dorji was again ordered to mobilize troops to drive them out.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year Kazakhs entered Uriankhai again; Cheren Dorji was again ordered to drive them out.

sentences.zh: 八月，以阿勒泰烏梁海右翼散秩大臣達什濟克巴調營未到，嚴議。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, because Altai Uriankhai Right Wing minister without regular rank Dashjikba failed to arrive when troops were mobilized, he was severely censured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Altai Uriankhai Right Wing minister Dashjikba was severely censured for failing to report when troops were mobilized.

sentences.zh: 予驅逐哈薩克妥速之阿勒泰左翼散秩大臣達爾瑪阿紮拉頭品頂戴，仍下部優敘。

translations.literal: The Altai Left Wing minister without regular rank Darmazhala, who had promptly driven out the Kazakhs, was given a first-rank hat button; he was still to be specially commended in the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Altai Left Wing minister Darmazhala, who had promptly driven out the Kazakhs, received a first-rank hat button and was to receive further commendation.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，科布多參贊大臣固慶奏：「達爾瑪阿紮拉時常稱疾偷安，不善撫馭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the Kobdo Participating Minister Guqing memorialized: "Darmazhala constantly claims illness and seeks ease, and is poor at governing and controlling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Kobdo Participating Minister Guqing reported, "Darmazhala constantly pleads illness to avoid duty and governs poorly.

sentences.zh: 所任散秩大臣管烏梁海四旗事務煩，遊牧遼闊，且與俄羅斯接壤，責任綦重，請令離任，以參領唐嘎祿署之。

translations.literal: The minister without regular rank he holds administers the affairs of four Uriankhai banners—affairs are numerous, pastures vast, and he adjoins Russia; responsibility is extremely heavy. We ask that he be removed from office and that commandant Tanggalu act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: His post oversees four Uriankhai banners across vast pastures bordering Russia—a weighty responsibility. We ask that he be removed and commandant Tanggalu act in his stead.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，與俄羅斯定西疆界約。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng a western frontier boundary treaty was concluded with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng a western frontier treaty was concluded with Russia.

sentences.zh: 同治三年八月，科布多參贊大臣廣鳳等奏：「卡倫以內阿勒泰烏梁海境內奇林河等地方十七處，有哈薩克公阿吉屬下之哈濟克居住。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Tongzhi the Kobdo Participating Minister Guangfeng and others memorialized: "Within the barrier posts, at seventeen places such as the Qilin River inside Altai Uriankhai territory, Khazaks under Kazakh prince Aji's dependents dwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Tongzhi Kobdo Participating Minister Guangfeng reported that Khazaks under Prince Aji were living at seventeen places within the barrier line in Altai Uriankhai territory, including the Qilin River region.

sentences.zh: 當分界未終之際，未便一旦驅逐。

translations.literal: While demarcation is not yet complete, it is not convenient to drive them out all at once.
translations.idiomatic: While the border has not yet been fixed, they cannot be expelled all at once.

sentences.zh: 倘分界後，萬不得已必須內遷，宜由塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣酌擇地方安置。

translations.literal: If after demarcation relocation within the interior is absolutely unavoidable, the Tarbagatai Participating Minister should choose a place to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: If relocation proves unavoidable after demarcation, the Tarbagatai Participating Minister should choose a site for them.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，俄人闌入是部庫什業莫多及塔布圖地方滋擾。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month Russians crossed into this tribe's Kushiyamodo and Tabutu places and caused disturbances.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh month Russians crossed into this tribe's Kushiyamodo and Tabutu regions and caused trouble.

sentences.zh: 明誼照會俄悉畢爾總督，先為查辦來我邊卡滋事官兵，俟明年兩國立界大臣會同建立牌博後，再派兵駐守。

translations.literal: Mingyi addressed a note to the Russian Siberian governor: first investigate and punish the troops who came to our barrier posts and caused trouble; after next year the two countries' boundary commissioners jointly erect markers, troops may again be stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Mingyi protested to the Russian Siberian governor to investigate troops who had caused trouble at the barrier posts and to station troops only after boundary commissioners from both countries set markers the following year.

sentences.zh: 四年，以伊、塔諸城回變，命設烏梁海台站，遞送科城至塔城文報軍餉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because of Muslim rebellions in the Ili and Tarbagatai cities, Uriankhai courier stations were ordered established to relay documents and military provisions from Kobdo city to Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, because of Muslim rebellions in Ili and Tarbagatai, Uriankhai courier stations were set up to relay dispatches and supplies from Kobdo to Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月，塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣錫霖劾廣鳳裁撤烏梁海台站，致文報軍餉阻滯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Tarbagatai Participating Minister Xilin impeached Guangfeng for abolishing Uriankhai courier stations, causing documents and military provisions to be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Tarbagatai Participating Minister Xilin impeached Guangfeng for abolishing the Uriankhai courier stations and blocking dispatches and supplies.

sentences.zh: 諭廣鳳等議處，仍令復設。

translations.literal: Guangfeng and others were instructed to deliberate on punishment; they were still ordered to restore the stations.
translations.idiomatic: Guangfeng and others were ordered disciplined and told to restore the stations.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，塔爾巴哈台失守，領隊大臣圖庫爾領額魯特兵移至是部。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year Tarbagatai fell; Brigade Commander Tukur led Oirat troops moved to this tribe's region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year Tarbagatai fell; Brigade Commander Tukur moved his Oirat troops into this region.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，命奎昌會同俄官建立科布多毗連俄境界牌鄂博。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year Kuichang was ordered jointly with Russian officials to erect Kobdo boundary markers and oboo adjoining Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year Kuichang was ordered to set up Kobdo boundary markers with Russian officials along the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 九月，奎昌等以俄使未到，奏俟明年會辦立界。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Kuichang and others, because the Russian envoy had not arrived, memorialized to wait until next year for joint boundary demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Kuichang reported that the Russian envoy had not come and asked to wait until the following year to set the boundary jointly.

sentences.zh: 八年，奎昌與俄立界使臣巴布闊福勘明自科布多東北邊界賽留格木山適中之布果素克達巴哈起，向西南順賽留格木山至奎屯鄂拉，往西沿大阿爾泰山至海留圖兩河之山；

translations.literal: In the eighth year Kuichang and the Russian boundary commissioner Babukuofo surveyed and fixed the line from Bogusuk Dabaha at the midpoint of Saylugem Mountain on Kobdo's northeastern border, southwest along Saylugem Mountain to Kuitun Ola, west along the Great Altai Mountains to the mountains of the two Hailiutu rivers;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Kuichang and Russian boundary commissioner Babukuofo surveyed the line from Bogusuk Dabaha on the northeastern Kobdo frontier, southwest along Saylugem Mountain to Kuitun Ola, then west along the Great Altai to the mountains between the two Hailiutu rivers;

sentences.zh: 轉往南，順是山直至察奇勒莫斯鄂拉；

translations.literal: turning south, following that mountain straight to Chaqirmos Ola;
translations.idiomatic: turning south along that range to Chaqirmos Ola;

sentences.zh: 轉往東南，沿齋桑淖爾之邊，循喀喇額爾齊斯河岸，至瑪尼圖噶圖勒幹卡倫，分為兩國交界。

translations.literal: turning southeast, along the border of Lake Zaisan, following the Kara Irtysh riverbank to the Manitu Gatulegan barrier post, dividing the boundary between the two countries.
translations.idiomatic: then southeast along Lake Zaisan, following the Kara Irtysh to the Manitu Gatulegan barrier post, where the border between the two countries was fixed.

sentences.zh: 建牌博凡二十：首曰布果素克達巴哈，次曰杜爾伯特達巴哈，曰塔布圖達巴哈，曰博勒齊爾，曰察幹布林哈蘇，曰烏蘭達巴哈，曰巴哈那斯達巴哈，曰薩爾那開，曰巴爾哈斯達巴哈，曰拜巴爾塔達巴哈，曰庫爾楚木，曰特勒克梯，曰固洛木拜，曰薩拉陶，曰薩勒欽車庫，曰特勒斯愛哩克，曰鄂裏雅布拉克，曰奇音克裏什，曰察奇勒莫斯，末曰瑪呢圖噶圖勒幹。

translations.literal: Twenty markers and oboo were erected in all: first Bogusuk Dabaha, then Dorbod Dabaha, Tabutu Dabaha, Boleqier, Chagan Bulinhasu, Ulan Dabaha, Bahanas Dabaha, Sarnakai, Barhas Dabaha, Baibarta Dabaha, Kurchumu, Teleketi, Guoluomubai, Salatao, Saleqin Cheku, Teles Ailike, Eriyaburak, Qiyinkirish, Chaqirmos, and last Manitu Gatulegan.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty markers were set: Bogusuk Dabaha first, then Dorbod Dabaha, Tabutu Dabaha, Boleqier, Chagan Bulinhasu, Ulan Dabaha, Bahanas Dabaha, Sarnakai, Barhas Dabaha, Baibarta Dabaha, Kurchumu, Teleketi, Guoluomubai, Salatao, Saleqin Cheku, Teles Ailike, Eriyaburak, Qiyinkirish, Chaqirmos, and finally Manitu Gatulegan.

sentences.zh: 自五月二十五日至七月三日竣事。

translations.literal: From the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month to the third day of the seventh month the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work was completed between the twenty-fifth of the fifth month and the third of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 十月，命棍噶紮拉參赴阿爾泰山收集徒眾，妥辦安插事宜，並免是部本年例貢貂皮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Gunggazhalcan was ordered to go to the Altai Mountains to gather disciples and followers, properly handle resettlement, and this tribe's annual tribute of sable pelts for the year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gunggazhalcan was sent to the Altai to gather followers and arrange resettlement; this tribe's annual sable tribute for the year was waived.

sentences.zh: 其後伊犁索倫營兵移至阿爾泰山，與塔城額魯特兵皆由棍噶紮拉參暫統之。

translations.literal: Afterward Ili Solon camp troops moved to the Altai Mountains, and Tacheng Oirat troops were all temporarily commanded by Gunggazhalcan.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ili Solon troops and Tacheng Oirat forces were moved to the Altai and placed temporarily under Gunggazhalcan's command.

sentences.zh: 十年，署伊犁將軍榮全奏，以由科布多屬紮哈沁五台以西至霍博克薩里一、二千里，非就地設台，後路必斷。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Acting Ili General Rongquan memorialized that from west of the five Zhakhachin stations under Kobdo to Hoboksar, one or two thousand li—unless courier stations were set up on the spot, the rear route would certainly be cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Acting Ili General Rongquan reported that the thousand-li stretch from west of Kobdo's five Zhakhachin stations to Hoboksar required courier posts on the spot or the supply line would be cut.

sentences.zh: 令烏梁海章蓋等於西翼設察罕通格、托克鄂博、德格圖阿滿三台，於東翼設多魯圖阿滿、額爾奇賽罕、烏裏雅斯三台。

translations.literal: Uriankhai zhanggai and others were ordered to set up three stations on the west wing—Chahan Tongge, Tok Oboo, Degtu Aman—and three on the east wing—Dorutu Aman, Erqi Saihan, and Uriyas.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai zhanggai were ordered to establish three stations on the west wing—Chahan Tongge, Tok Oboo, and Degtu Aman—and three on the east—Dorutu Aman, Erqi Saihan, and Uriyas.

sentences.zh: 自是為科、塔兩城孔道。

translations.literal: From this it became the thoroughfare between Kobdo and Tacheng cities.
translations.idiomatic: This became the main route between Kobdo and Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調棍噶紮拉參所部索倫、額魯特兵赴塔城。
