translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Solon and Oirat troops under Gunggazhalcan were transferred to Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Gunggazhalcan's Solon and Oirat troops were transferred to Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 十二年十一月，回匪竄新土爾扈特之布林根河，擾是部境，台站官兵紛紛逃散。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Muslim bandits slipped into the Bulgan River of the New Torghut, harassed this tribe's border, and courier-station troops and officers fled in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Muslim rebels slipped into the New Torghut Bulgan River region, raided this tribe's border, and courier-station troops fled in disorder.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊領隊大臣錫綸率所部民勇自阿爾泰山南移營烏龍古河南岸，追至霍博克河下游，擊破之。

translations.literal: Urumqi Brigade Commander Xilun led his civilian militia from south of the Altai, moved camp to the south bank of the Wulungu River, pursued to the lower Hobok River, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Urumqi Brigade Commander Xilun led his militia from south of the Altai to the south bank of the Wulungu River, pursued the rebels to the lower Hobok River, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 匪竄綏來縣北境，科布多參贊大臣保英等飭烏梁海速將軍台移回原處安設。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to the northern border of Suilai County; the Kobdo Participating Minister Baoying and others ordered the Uriankhai quickly to move the military courier stations back and reinstall them in their original places.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to northern Suilai County; Kobdo Participating Minister Baoying ordered the Uriankhai to restore the military courier stations to their original sites at once.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年七月，以棍噶紮拉參在烏梁海達彥地方收撫哈薩克，擅殺頭目柯伯史之子，諭錫綸飭棍噶紮拉參即回籍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year of Guangxu, because Gunggazhalcan at the Uriankhai Dayan place was winning over Kazakhs and on his own authority killed the son of chief Keboshi, Xilun was instructed to order Gunggazhalcan to return to his native place at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year of Guangxu Gunggazhalcan, while winning over Kazakhs at Dayan in Uriankhai territory, killed chief Keboshi's son without authorization; Xilun was ordered to send him home at once.

sentences.zh: 八年，俄人議重劃科、塔中俄之界，欲占哈巴河一帶。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Russians proposed redemarcating the Kobdo and Tacheng Sino-Russian border, wishing to occupy the Kaba River region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Russia proposed redrawing the Kobdo and Tacheng border and sought to occupy the Kaba River region.

sentences.zh: 科布多參贊大臣清泰等奏：「俄人數百名突至哈巴河。

translations.literal: The Kobdo Participating Minister Qingtai and others memorialized: "Several hundred Russians suddenly arrived at the Kaba River.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Participating Minister Qingtai reported that several hundred Russians had suddenly arrived at the Kaba River.

sentences.zh: 查新條約內，奎峒山即阿爾泰山。

translations.literal: According to investigation, in the new treaty Kuitong Mountain is the Altai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The new treaty identifies Kuitong Mountain as the Altai range.

sentences.zh: 任其勘改，實有關礙。

translations.literal: To allow them to survey and alter it would in fact involve serious harm.
translations.idiomatic: Allowing them to resurvey the line would do real harm.

sentences.zh: 」八月，阿勒泰左翼散秩大臣等復呈清泰等以「前次界劃烏梁海西北境侵佔已多，此次若再占哈巴河，蒙民無地自容，誓死不能退讓」。

translations.literal: " In the eighth month the Altai Left Wing minister without regular rank and others again presented to Qingtai and others: "The previous demarcation already encroached greatly on the Uriankhai northwest border; if the Kaba River is occupied again, Mongol commoners will have no room to live and swear they cannot yield even at the cost of death."
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth month Altai Left Wing ministers reported to Qingtai that the previous border had already taken much Uriankhai northwestern territory; if the Kaba River were lost as well, the Mongols would have nowhere to live and swore they could not yield.

sentences.zh: 諭清安、額爾慶額會商金順、升泰妥籌。

translations.literal: Qing'an and Erqing'e were instructed to consult with Jinshun and Sheng Tai for proper arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: Qing'an and Erqing'e were told to consult Jinshun and Sheng Tai on how to proceed.

sentences.zh: 九年，額爾慶額偕參贊大臣升泰先期馳赴塞上，察邊塞沖要，辨山川主名。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Erqing'e together with Participating Minister Sheng Tai went ahead in haste to the frontier, inspected strategic points on the border, and distinguished the principal names of mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Erqing'e and Participating Minister Sheng Tai went ahead to the frontier, surveyed strategic border points, and verified the principal mountain and river names.

sentences.zh: 以棄哈巴河、奎峒山二要地烏梁海、哈薩克之眾均無所依，與俄官抗爭，相持兼旬，改以哈巴河以西阿拉喀別河為界，得展地百三十餘里，分道安設新界牌博。

translations.literal: Because abandoning the two key places of the Kaba River and Kuitong Mountain would leave Uriankhai and Kazakh peoples with nowhere to rely on, they contended with Russian officials for more than ten days; the boundary was changed to the Alakhbiek River west of the Kaba River, gaining more than 130 li of territory, and new boundary markers were set up along separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing that losing the Kaba River and Kuitong Mountain would leave Uriankhai and Kazakhs homeless, they argued with Russian officials for over ten days. The border was redrawn at the Alakhbiek River west of the Kaba River, gaining more than 130 li, and new markers were erected.

sentences.zh: 既竣事，額爾慶額又繞北山道大彥淖爾安插烏梁海兩翼部落，以和裏木圖河、雅瑪圖、喲洛圖、西裏布拉克為夏季遊牧，以罕達蓋圖河、塔里雅圖、青格裏河、烏龍古河為冬季遊牧，而哈巴河仍由塔城置戍。

translations.literal: When the work was done, Erqing'e again went by the northern mountain route to Dayan Nuur to resettle the two Uriankhai wings: summer pastures at Helimutu River, Yamatu, Yaoluotu, and Xilibulak; winter pastures at Handagaitu River, Taliyatu, Qingge River, and Wulungu River; while the Kaba River was still garrisoned by Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, Erqing'e resettled both Uriankhai wings at Dayan Nuur by the northern route, assigning summer pastures along the Helimutu, Yamatu, Yaoluotu, and Xilibulak rivers and winter pastures along the Handagaitu, Taliyatu, Qingge, and Wulungu rivers, while Tacheng kept a garrison on the Kaba River.

sentences.zh: 以金順奏，諭阿爾泰山烏梁海屬一帶遊牧地方，請飭棍噶紮拉參交回安插蒙民。

translations.literal: On Jinshun's memorial, the Altai Uriankhai pasture region was instructed: Gunggazhalcan was ordered to return it and resettle the Mongol people.
translations.idiomatic: On Jinshun's memorial, Gunggazhalcan was ordered to return the Altai Uriankhai pasturelands and resettle the Mongols there.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，以沙克都爾紮布等奏，復催棍噶紮拉參將徒眾仍回塔城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twelfth year, on Shakduerjab and others' memorial, Gunggazhalcan was again urged to move his followers back to Tacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twelfth year Shakduerjab and others again urged Gunggazhalcan to move his followers back to Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 十三年，諭劉錦棠等於新疆擇安插棍噶紮拉參之地。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Liu Jintang and others were instructed to choose in Xinjiang a place to resettle Gunggazhalcan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Liu Jintang was told to find a site in Xinjiang for Gunggazhalcan's resettlement.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月，劉錦棠奏移棍噶紮拉參徒眾於庫爾喀喇烏蘇屬之八英溝，讓還科布多借地。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year Liu Jintang memorialized moving Gunggazhalcan's followers to Bayingou under Kurkara Usu and returning the borrowed Kobdo lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifteenth year Liu Jintang reported moving Gunggazhalcan's followers to Bayingou in Kurkara Usu and returning the land borrowed from Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 承化寺就近所招徒眾，聽留居其寺哈巴河一帶。

translations.literal: Followers recruited nearby by Chenghua Temple were permitted to remain dwelling in the Kaba River region near the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Disciples recruited near Chenghua Temple were allowed to remain in the Kaba River region.

sentences.zh: 塔城自借地以來，即已派兵駐守，未便委去，俾俄人得乘便南下，從之。

translations.literal: Tacheng had stationed troops on the borrowed land from the start and could not abandon it, lest Russians seize the opportunity to push south; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Tacheng had garrisoned the borrowed land from the start and could not withdraw lest Russia push south; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月，沙克都爾紮布、額爾慶額、魁福會勘，奏哈巴河借地暫難歸還，以塔城兩次分界後，蒙、哈不敷分住，請將借地展緩三年交割。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year Shakduerjab, Erqing'e, and Kuifu jointly surveyed and memorialized that the borrowed Kaba River land could not yet be returned; after Tacheng's two demarcations Mongols and Kazakhs could not all be housed, and they asked to extend handover of the borrowed land by three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year Shakduerjab, Erqing'e, and Kuifu reported that the borrowed Kaba River land could not yet be returned because Mongols and Kazakhs lacked room after Tacheng's two border settlements, and asked for a three-year extension.

sentences.zh: 烏梁海困苦，擬令塔城哈薩克酌給牲畜，並籌安插逃戶，派兵駐守，允之。

translations.literal: The Uriankhai were in distress; it was proposed to have Tacheng Kazakhs give livestock as appropriate, plan resettlement of refugee households, and station troops; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai were destitute; Tacheng Kazakhs were to provide livestock, refugee households were to be resettled, and troops stationed; the plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 其後科城屢請收回哈巴河，塔城爭之，迄未決。

translations.literal: Afterward Kobdo city repeatedly asked to recover the Kaba River; Tacheng contested it, and no decision was ever reached.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo repeatedly asked for the Kaba River back; Tacheng resisted, and the dispute was never settled.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，邊防戒嚴，參贊大臣瑞洵檄烏梁海每旗挑兵二百名，半馬牛步，駐防本旗。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the frontier was placed on alert; Participating Minister Ruixun ordered each Uriankhai banner to select two hundred troops, half mounted and half on foot, to garrison its own banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the frontier was militarized; Participating Minister Ruixun ordered each Uriankhai banner to raise two hundred men, half mounted and half on foot, to garrison its territory.

sentences.zh: 事定，撤之。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis passed, they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 以烏梁海各旗保護俄商貨物，安全遊牧，一再請獎。

translations.literal: Because the Uriankhai banners protected Russian merchants' goods and pastured safely, rewards were repeatedly requested.
translations.idiomatic: The Uriankhai banners were repeatedly commended for protecting Russian trade goods and keeping the pastures secure.

sentences.zh: 二十九年閏五月，予烏梁海左右翼散秩大臣額爾克、舒諾三音博勒克均頭品頂戴，左翼總管倭齊爾紮布、桑敦紮布、右翼總管棍布紮布、瓦齊爾紮布均二品頂戴，左翼副都統察罕博勒克亦予獎。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year the Uriankhai Left and Right Wing ministers without regular rank Erke and Shunu Sanyin Bolek were both given first-rank hat buttons; Left Wing superintendents Woqierjab and Sundunjab and Right Wing superintendents Gunbujab and Wazirjab were all given second-rank hat buttons; Left Wing vice commander-in-chief Chahan Bolek was also rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-ninth year ministers Erke and Shunu Sanyin Bolek received first-rank hat buttons; superintendents Woqierjab, Sundunjab, Gunbujab, and Wazirjab received second-rank buttons; and vice commander Chahan Bolek was also rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，塔城以哈巴城地交還科城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Tacheng returned the Kaba region to Kobdo city.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Tacheng returned the Kaba region to Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 三十年五月，改設科布多辦事大臣駐阿爾泰山，以錫恆為之，仍駐承化寺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year the Kobdo Resident Minister post was reestablished at the Altai Mountains, with Xiheng appointed, still residing at Chenghua Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year a Kobdo Resident Minister was posted to the Altai with Xiheng in the post, still based at Chenghua Temple.

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月，定阿勒泰練陸軍馬隊一標、砲隊一營，設哈巴河防營委員，及沙紮蓋台至承化寺馬撥十六處，每處設蒙古馬兵五名，馬十匹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year one Altai trained army cavalry battalion and one artillery company were fixed, a Kaba River defense camp commissioner was established, and sixteen horse-relay posts from Shazhagaitai to Chenghua Temple were set up, each with five Mongol cavalrymen and ten horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year Altai was assigned one cavalry battalion and one artillery company, a Kaba River defense commissioner was appointed, and sixteen relay posts from Shazhagaitai to Chenghua Temple were established with five Mongol cavalrymen and ten horses each.

sentences.zh: 開辦承化寺、庫克、呼布克木、哈巴河四處屯牧，建城署房屋，撥常年經費十三萬兩，開辦經費三十一萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: Colonization and pastoral farming were opened at four places—Chenghua Temple, Kuke, Hobukemu, and Kaba River—government buildings were constructed, 130,000 taels of annual funds were allocated, and startup funds of more than 310,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Colonization was opened at Chenghua Temple, Kuke, Hobukemu, and the Kaba River; government buildings were erected with 130,000 taels in annual funds and over 310,000 taels in startup capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月，是部七旗劃隸阿勒泰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month this tribe's seven banners were placed under Altai jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month this tribe's seven banners were placed under Altai administration.

sentences.zh: 三十四年四月，錫恆奏停辦布倫托海上渠，下渠距水較近，擬再試種一年，克木奇官屯暫撥民辦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year Xiheng memorialized stopping the upper canal on Lake Burultoqai; the lower canal was closer to water and was to be tried for planting one more year; the Kemuchi official colony was temporarily turned over to civilian management.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-fourth year Xiheng reported suspending the upper Burultoqai canal, trying the lower canal for another year of planting, and temporarily turning the Kemuchi official farm over to civilians.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年二月，署辦事大臣延年奏開距承化寺七十里之紅墩渠，安插農民。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Xuantong Acting Resident Minister Yannian memorialized opening the Hongdun canal seventy li from Chenghua Temple to resettle farmers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Xuantong Acting Resident Minister Yannian proposed opening the Hongdun canal seventy li from Chenghua Temple to settle farmers.

sentences.zh: 下部知之。

translations.literal: The ministries were informed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were notified.

sentences.zh: 地兼耕牧，有礦，有鹽。

translations.literal: The land supports both farming and pastoralism; there are mines and salt.
translations.idiomatic: The land supports farming and grazing, with mines and salt deposits.

sentences.zh: 是部有佐領七，副都統暨左右翼散秩大臣均兼一旗總管。

translations.literal: This tribe has seven assistant commandants; the vice commander-in-chief and the Left and Right Wing ministers without regular rank each also serve as superintendent of one banner.
translations.idiomatic: This tribe has seven assistant commandants; the vice commander and the left and right wing ministers each also serve as superintendent of one banner.

sentences.zh: 卡倫自再劃界後，南起右翼散秩大臣旗之阿拉克別克，而北曰阿克塔斯，又東北曰克雜那阿斯，曰薩斯，曰呼吉爾圖布拉克，曰烏松呼吉爾圖，轉東曰胡布蘇，訖羅蓋布，東北至左翼散秩大臣旗之霍洞淖爾止，凡八卡倫。

translations.literal: Barrier posts after redemarcation: starting south from Alakhbiek in the Right Wing minister's banner, north to Aktas, then northeast to Kezina'asi, Sas, Hujirtu Burak, Usun Hujirtu, turning east to Hubusu, ending at Luogaibu, northeast to Huodong Nuor in the Left Wing minister's banner—in all eight barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: After redemarcation there were eight barrier posts from Alakhbiek in the right wing southward to Aktas, then northeast through Kezina'asi, Sas, Hujirtu Burak, Usun Hujirtu, east to Hubusu and Luogaibu, ending at Huodong Nuor in the left wing.

sentences.zh: 山之著者：西吉克圖山、荄拉圖山、霍穆達山、哈喇溫爾常山。

translations.literal: Notable mountains: Xijiketu Mountain, Gailatu Mountain, Homuda Mountain, and Halawen'erchang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Notable mountains include Xijiketu, Gailatu, Homuda, and Halawen'erchang.

sentences.zh: 水之著者：察罕西魯河、薩格賽河、薩克布多河、青格裏河、額爾齊斯河。

translations.literal: Notable waters: Chahan Xilu River, Sagesai River, Sakbudo River, Qingge River, and Irtysh River.
translations.idiomatic: Notable rivers include the Chahan Xilu, Sagesai, Sakbudo, Qingge, and Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海，在科布多之西北，東唐努烏梁海，南阿勒泰烏梁海，西與北均俄羅斯。

translations.literal: Altai Nuur Uriankhai lies northwest of Kobdo; to the east Tannu Uriankhai; to the south Altai Uriankhai; to the west and north Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Altai Nuur Uriankhai lies northwest of Kobdo, bordered on the east by Tannu Uriankhai, on the south by Altai Uriankhai, and on the west and north by Russia.

sentences.zh: 初屬準噶爾。

translations.literal: They originally belonged to the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: They were originally subject to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年九月，賽音諾顏扎薩克貝勒車木楚克劄布招撫阿爾泰山烏梁海。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Sayin Noyan Zasak Beile Chemchukjab won over the Altai Mountain Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year of Qianlong Sayin Noyan Zasak Beile Chemchukjab pacified the Altai Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 有特勒伯克扎爾納克者，阿勒泰淖爾之烏梁海宰桑，攜屬至。

translations.literal: There was one Teleboke Zharnak, zaisang of the Altai Nuur Uriankhai, who came with his dependents.
translations.idiomatic: Teleboke Zharnak, zaisang of the Altai Nuur Uriankhai, arrived with his people.

sentences.zh: 詔車木楚克紮布定貢賞例，宣示德意。

translations.literal: Chemchukjab was ordered to fix tribute and reward regulations and proclaim imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: Chemchukjab was ordered to set tribute and reward regulations and proclaim the court's benevolence.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海宰桑特勒伯克等為總管。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Altai Nuur Uriankhai zaisang Teleboke and others were appointed superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month zaisang Teleboke and others of Altai Nuur Uriankhai were made superintendents.

sentences.zh: 二十三年秋，烏梁海總管阿拉善、恩克等叛，車木楚克紮布剿阿拉善等，就擒。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-third year Uriankhai superintendents Alashan, Enke, and others rebelled; Chemchukjab suppressed Alashan and others and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-third year superintendents Alashan and Enke rebelled; Chemchukjab captured Alashan and his followers.

sentences.zh: 恩兄竄哈屯河，冬，擒之。

translations.literal: Enke's elder brother fled to the Hatun River; in winter he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Enke's elder brother fled to the Hatun River and was captured that winter.

sentences.zh: 尋定是部為二旗，各設總管一，歲貢貉皮如例，隸科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Soon this tribe was fixed as two banners, each with one superintendent, annual tribute of raccoon-dog pelts as regulations provided, subordinate to the Kobdo Participating Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe was soon organized as two banners, each with a superintendent, paying annual raccoon-dog pelts as tribute under the Kobdo Participating Minister.

sentences.zh: 道光中，查邊之政漸弛，俄人始築城於是部之吹河，我查邊界鄂博者往往不至其地。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang period border-inspection policy gradually slackened; Russians first built a fort on this tribe's Chui River, and our personnel inspecting boundary oboo often did not reach those places.
translations.idiomatic: During Daoguang border inspection grew lax; Russians built a fort on the Chui River in this region, and Chinese boundary inspectors often failed to reach the markers.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，定西疆界約，俄國畫界清單遂將是部包去。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng the western frontier boundary treaty was concluded; Russia's demarcation list then encircled this tribe's territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng a western frontier treaty was signed; Russia's demarcation list cut off this entire tribe's territory.

sentences.zh: 同治六年七月，科布多參贊大臣廣鳳等奏俄雅什達喇城衙門給阿勒泰淖爾兩旗總管文，言阿勒泰淖爾、綽羅什拜、巴什庫斯、吹河均系俄羅斯遊牧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Tongzhi the Kobdo Participating Minister Guangfeng and others memorialized that the Russian Yashidara city yamen had sent documents to the two-banner superintendents of Altai Nuur stating that Altai Nuur, Choluoshibai, Bashikus, and the Chui River were all Russian pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Tongzhi Guangfeng reported that the Russian Yashidara authorities had told the Altai Nuur superintendents that Altai Nuur, Choluoshibai, Bashikus, and the Chui River were Russian grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 如有人言系中國遊牧，拿送俄城。

translations.literal: If anyone said they were Chinese pastures, he was to be seized and sent to the Russian city.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who claimed they were Chinese pastures was to be seized and sent to the Russian authorities.

sentences.zh: 又俄人來綽羅什拜地方伐木，已飭總管察罕等善言開導，靜候兩國分界大臣將疆界議定換約，立界後，再按照所分界限遵行，此時不可伐木蓋房，致滋事端。

translations.literal: Moreover Russians came to Choluoshibai to cut timber; Superintendent Chahan and others had been instructed to guide them with good words, quietly await the two countries' boundary commissioners fixing the border and exchanging treaties, and after markers were erected follow the divided boundary—at this time they must not cut timber or build houses and cause incidents.
translations.idiomatic: Russians also came to Choluoshibai to log timber; Superintendent Chahan was told to reason with them and wait until boundary commissioners fixed the border, after which the new line would apply—but for now they must not log or build houses and provoke trouble.

sentences.zh: 時俄國官兵執去我查閱哈屯河扎薩克紮那紮布及台吉差官、蒙古員兵等，阻我查邊道路，稱是部遊牧為俄國地面，不許中國人往來。

translations.literal: At the time Russian troops seized our personnel inspecting the Hatun River—Zasak Zanajab and taiji dispatch officers, Mongol soldiers, and others—blocked our border-inspection routes, and claimed this tribe's pastures were Russian territory, forbidding Chinese to come and go.
translations.idiomatic: Russian troops seized Chinese inspectors at the Hatun River—including Zasak Zanajab, taiji officers, and Mongol soldiers—blocked border inspection routes, and declared this tribe's pastures Russian territory, barring Chinese passage.

sentences.zh: 十月，阿勒泰淖爾總管莽泰等報俄官取莽泰旗下一百四十餘人及總管察罕旗下二百四十餘人手印。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Altai Nuur Superintendent Mangtai and others reported that Russian officials took thumbprints from more than 140 persons under Mangtai's banner and more than 240 under Superintendent Chahan's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Superintendent Mangtai reported that Russian officials had taken thumbprints from more than 140 of his banner's people and more than 240 of Superintendent Chahan's.

sentences.zh: 九月，明誼、錫霖、博勒果索與俄分界大臣照議單勘分西界，是部地遂非清有。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Mingyi, Xilin, and Boleguosuo with the Russian boundary commissioner surveyed the western border according to the negotiation list; this tribe's land was thus no longer Qing territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mingyi, Xilin, and Boleguosuo surveyed the western border with the Russian commissioner under the negotiating list; this tribe's land passed out of Qing control.

sentences.zh: 初議遷是部誠心內附者於卡內，而總管莽泰等言兩旗人丁祈全入卡內住牧。

translations.literal: At first it was proposed to move those of this tribe who had sincerely submitted inward to within the barrier posts, but Superintendent Mangtai and others said the people of both banners prayed to enter entirely within the posts to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: At first those who had sincerely submitted were to be moved inside the barrier posts, but Superintendent Mangtai said both banners wished to move entirely inside to graze.

sentences.zh: 廣鳳等諭以「所被俄國分去地面舊住人丁，隨地歸為俄國，務令安居故土，各守舊業，立界後斷不致仍前擾害」。

translations.literal: Guangfeng and others instructed them: "The people who formerly dwelt on the lands divided off to Russia follow the land and become Russian; see that they settle peacefully in their old homes, each keep their old livelihoods, and after markers are erected they will certainly not suffer disturbance as before."
translations.idiomatic: Guangfeng told them, "Those who remain on land assigned to Russia must stay on their old homes, keep their livelihoods, and after the border is fixed will not be harmed as before."

sentences.zh: 隨令莽岱等出卡回牧，並內徙之議亦輟。

translations.literal: Mangdai and others were then ordered to leave the posts and return to pasture, and the proposal for inward migration was also dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Mangdai and others were ordered to leave the posts and return to pasture, and the plan for inward migration was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 是部有佐領四。

translations.literal: This tribe has four assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: This tribe has four assistant commandants.
